notes.title: One-year Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, today marks the one-year anniversary of Haiku's release!

I've put together a short video to look back at this wonderful year, and also to showcase what's to come in the future for the game.

[previewyoutube=H46l1B8JhBk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]To summarize the video[/h2]

Achievements:
[list]
[*] Successfully launching a game on Steam
[*] Having more than 1000 reviews (91% positive)
[*] Getting married!
[*] Attending PAX West and meeting people
[*] Launching the game on the Nintendo Switch
[*] Releasing a free update - Corrupt Mode
[*] Raising over $50,000 for charity with Humble Bundle
[*] Winning three awards; Best Solo-dev Game, Hidden Gem, and Best Estonian Game of 2022
[*] And learning to speedrun my own game in 36 minutes
[/list]
Still to come:
[list]
[*] A new update - Obscure Information!
[*] Kickstarter rewards
[*] And a physical edition for the Nintendo Switch!!
[/list]
[h2]Thank you![/h2]

I also want to take a moment to thank you, the people who played and enjoyed this little game of mine, your words and reactions have motivated me to keep working hard on the game. I cannot wait to see what the future holds for Haiku and more games down the line! ːorange_heartː

It features a huge world, tons of abilities, challenging platforming sections, and lots of boss fights - it even has a assist mode for those who prefer a more relaxed experience - check it out below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1674780/

[h3]It includes a special Haiku skin:[/h3]

If you own Haiku the Robot in your Steam library, you will gain special access to a hidden skin! 
You can take Haiku on another adventure, but this time through a magic mushroom kingdom ːHappyHaikuː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/042eec80f6e8cb263424afb4033a339066da3443.gif[/img]

We have also teamed up to offer you a "Complete the set" bundle, so if you are missing either game, you can purchase it through the bundle with a 20% discount.

And if you don't own either game, well now is a great time to get both games with a nice discount!

notes.title: 1-Month Update and Limited Time Plushie!
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

It's been a little over a month since the game launched and I'm blown away by the response it's received!

This is my first commercial project, so it's been an incredible feeling to watch Streamers play with their audiences, speedrunners break and tear the code apart, and modders start making mods for the game. Not to mention the [b]94%[/b] positive reviews out of ~600 on Steam!

This whole experience has been incredibly humbling, I can't wait to bring the game to the Nintendo Switch, and to release some more content updates.


[h2]Limited Edition Haiku Plushie![/h2]

Haiku the Robot is now available as a plushie for a limited time only! The design features super soft fabric and a velcro detachable sword. Haiku is leaving the world of Arcadia behind and possibly coming to your house to explore!

More information can be found here: [url=https://shop.makeship.com/3Gib1GD]https://shop.makeship.com/3Gib1GD[/url]
[b]Plushies are limited edition and can only be ordered until June 23rd![/b]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE 02: Introducing the Heat Gauge!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I hope all is well. The sun has finally started to show its face in Estonia so that makes me a happy little fellow. In this update, I'll be revealing one of the new mechanics in the game: the [b]Heat Gauge![/b]

[h2]Heat Gauge showcase video[/h2]
[previewyoutube=L0nJxnGnuYE;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]Heat Gauge[/b] shows how much you have heated when using your robot abilities. If you get too hot then you will become overheated and you will need to wait a short period until you fully cool down. Once you have cooled off, you will be able to use all your abilities again.
On top of the auto-cooling system, hitting enemies also cools you down faster. This promotes a slightly more aggressive playstyle for players who like that kind of thing.
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Abilities and costs[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/a683bd0aeb8ded3d5f8ff0505bb7153702124e77.gif[/img]

[b]Slide + dodge:[/b] Haiku can now slide across the floor to dodge and pass through enemies. This uses 1/3rd of your heat gauge. You can also use this ability to get around faster but be careful not to overheat yourself!
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/9233244c614ecf90235c084f1b213b09fefbe24a.gif[/img]

[b]Blink + teleport:[/b] Later on, you will gain the ability to blink through time and space. This replaces the slide and dodge which can only be used on the floor. With this ability, you can also teleport through some world objects and use it while airborne.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/da7f9f2c47b919be8dada862b769cd106bb7e5a9.gif[/img]

[b]Super bomb:[/b] Haiku can use his inner-circuitry to create a quick explosion that deals triple damage in a small radius. It can also be used to unblock some paths in the world. This ability generates 2/3rds of heat.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/4b809748584e55aa937c619f3eb45281996c126b.gif[/img]

[b]Zipline:[/b] A late-game ability that helps you travel through previously explored areas a bit faster. Currently, used to travel horizontally and upwards. This ability uses 1/3rd of your heat gauge.
[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/1d48846388bcb03a23c609330b6fc5ce074b988e.gif[/img]

[b]Attacking enemies:[/b] Haiku can cool down faster if he attacks nearby enemies. This means you can create different combos of attacking, bombing, and dodging while you manage your heat resource bar.
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Environment interactions[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/8a57e4a8b36a288e0dd8a67b23a2e34625bcc376.gif[/img]

Different environments affect your heat gauge. For example, when traveling through the incinerator area then you will become persistently overheated.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]I want to hear your ideas![/h2]
Let me know in the comment section if you have any thoughts or ideas on how the Heat Gauge should be used. It could be interesting upgrades that cool your heat gauge faster or new abilities that you think would tie in nicely with the design.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]If you liked this update then consider adding Haiku to your wishlist![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231880/Haiku_the_Robot/

notes.title: DEV UPDATE 01: Progress is good
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I'm Jordan, the solo-developer behind [b]Haiku, the Robot[/b].

I've been working full-time on the game for approximately 3 months now (thanks to a successful [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/haiku-the-robot/haiku-the-robot]Kickstarter campaign[/url]) and I wanted to share some snapshots of the progress that's been made so far.

A lot of work has been going into planning the map (which is the most important part of a good Metroidvania), the levels, and passing them all over to Unity game engine. I haven't focused on environment details yet so the screenshots are demonstrating what I like to call a "first pass" - which means a quick dressing of the room to set the tone and mood.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/d82803ef05f38e7152d3971d5b735bc91f2a0790.png[/img]
[h3]The Ruins (a working title)[/h3]
This is one of my favorite areas in the game. It's so different from the normal machine world that Haiku lives in and it offers a nice change of pace and scenery while exploring. This is an exciting area which I can't wait to dedicate more time to and fill out with small details and story elements.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/e9af11a55bc8c888ccbdbee7aa48e1f1cea2f158.png[/img]
[h3]The Incinerator (a working title)[/h3]
This is definitely one of the more intense areas of the game. Here, the flames burn fiercely as garbage is consumed to produce power/electricity. One of the next steps for this area is to add fire-type enemies, some interesting platforming, and potentially a [spoiler]boss fight[/spoiler]!

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/01185e4c760a21c315d7a5cd5c2ad8f760a36fb3.png[/img]
[h3]The Core[/h3]
This area acts as the central hub. Pretty much everything in Haiku's world needs electricity to function so it branches off into many different areas, The Incinerator being one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/c44503d3d08e3dd470a0b8ad06d909810bb0448f.png[/img]

As I am close to finishing transferring all the levels into Unity's game engine, I've started to work on trickier platforming as well. It's fun coming up with ways to introduce new platform mechanics to the player, teaching them, and then testing their abilities - I hope it adds another layer to the gameplay while you explore. (Screenshot above)

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/5463ab119c925977437fcd41f282e1df1b18218d.png[/img]
[h3]Steampunk Town[/h3]
After I've finished moving over the last few levels to Unity, I can start to design and add more details to the world, such as this cute little town (which is still missing characters). I will also be able to focus more time on new bosses, enemies, and story elements to further enrich the experience.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Which area are you most excited for? Let me know in the comments below.
[/h3]

Overall, the game's progress is going very well. And things seem to be on schedule for my initial October launch plan but there is still a long road ahead. Watch this space as I will make sure to post more development updates in the future. Thanks!

[hr][/hr]
